articles.title: Messi vs. Yamal: A World Cup Final Decades in the Making
articles.summary: Argentina and Spain clash in the World Cup final. Can Lionel Messi, 39, secure another title, or will 19-year-old Lamine Yamal lead Spain's young squad to glory?

articles.title: Andy Burnham Becomes UK Prime Minister, Vows 'More Breathing Room'
articles.summary: Andy Burnham is set to become the UK's seventh PM in a decade. He promises 'more breathing room' on cost of living, will scrap digital ID plans, and take water and energy companies into public ownership.

articles.title: MLS Aims to Convert World Cup Fever into Long-Term Fan Growth
articles.summary: As the World Cup ends, MLS launches a major campaign to attract new fans. Teams like Chicago Fire hosted watch parties drawing 60,000 people, and 22 clubs offer free first tickets to convert casual viewers into regulars.
